SELECT msg.message_count, rep.reply_count, msg.today_count + rep.today_count AS today_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS message_count, COUNT( CASE WHEN created_at >= UTC_DATE() THEN 1 END ) AS today_count FROM messages WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ) msg CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS reply_count, COUNT( CASE WHEN r.created_at >= UTC_DATE() THEN 1 END ) AS today_count FROM replies r JOIN messages m ON m.id = r.message_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL ) rep
